SaveSlot.title: SaveSlot
SaveSlot.description: Cloud game save slot for Spider-Love canonical story progress, romantic bond metrics, and unlocked memories for Isabella.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

slotName.description: Display label for the save slot.

currentSceneIndex.description: Current interactive scene/beat index within the chapter.

bondScore.description: Canonical romantic bond score between Peter and Isabella (0 to 100).

witPoints.description: Spider-Man humor and complicity points earned.

unlockedMemories.description: List of unlocked canonical memory IDs (max 20).

choiceHistory.description: List of recorded canonical story choice IDs (max 30).

playTimeSeconds.description: Total elapsed play time in seconds.

finished.description: Whether the canonical story finale has been completed.

lastChapterTitle.description: Human-readable title of the last saved chapter.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when save slot was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when save slot was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/saveSlots/{slotId}.description: Per-user cloud save slots for Spider-Love story progress and romantic keepsakes.
